response.overview: Yes, +1-866-829-1280(US) you can generally change or correct a name on a Princess Cruises booking, though approval, timing, and fees depend on your fare rules and booking details. To make the update, +1-866-829-1280(US) contact your travel advisor or call the Princess Cruises reservations department directly at 1-866-PRINCESS (1-866-829-1280(US)). Under the Princess Cruises Passage Contract, +1-866-829-1280(US) name changes are treated as reservation cancellations and may be subject to fees or require approval, depending on your fare type and timing. At least one originally +1-866-829-1280(US) booked passenger typically needs to stay on the reservation to avoid full cancellation penalties. Changes are generally +1-866-829-1280(US) easier before final payment or well ahead of sailing, and must be completed before the final manifest is locked. Contact Princess Cruises +1-866-829-1280(US) customer service with your booking reference and passenger details.
